description: Source code for AAudioBinderClient class managing Android AAudio service connection and stream control.

classes.name: AAudioBinderClient
classes.description: Client class for managing AAudio service connection and stream operations.

methods.name: getAAudioService
methods.description: Helper to obtain the AAudio service interface, with reconnection logic.

methods.name: dropAAudioService
methods.description: Resets the service adapter, dropping the current connection.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens an audio stream with specified request and configuration.

methods.name: getStreamDescription
methods.description: Retrieves description of the in-memory queues for a stream.

methods.name: registerAudioThread
methods.description: Registers a thread as a low latency audio thread.

methods.name: unregisterAudioThread
methods.description: Unregisters a thread from low latency audio processing.

methods.name: exitStandby
methods.description: Exits standby mode for a stream and retrieves endpoint info.
